title: Closing: news release and signing off
summary: They ask Ron to send a news release, Fields tells how to label pictures, and Love signs off at 5:07 P.M. on November 1, 1981.

story.theme_name: Thanks and goodbyes: closing the interview
story.community_name: Closing the interview: thanks, goodbyes and tape running out

blocks.x: I wish you would speak to Ron and insist that he put this on the news media.
I'll address this to Ron and hope he gets it now. If Ron would send a news release--

In our newspaper--you see, I write a column for the paper, a weekly column, I didn't have one today because I was too busy to write it. I did one last week about the University of Iowa, doing a residency, but if Ron sent a news release (inaudible) to

my paper, The Omaha World Herald, they would print it and then I would get it on the syndicate. But it would be improper for me to write it because they would think I was building my own self up or build you up because you're my friend.
So I'll send Ron a letter to send a news release on this, for better or worse, assuming that we've done a great job. I sure hope we have.

I think that's all I have. You can get those pictures together and write a note on there, so he'll know what's what about them and then if he makes mention in his letter, he'll register them and put on there to make copies and return them.
Well, at 5:07, Sunday, November 1, 1981, Ernie Fields and I, Preston Love, will sign off.
(Whereupon, interview is completed and transcript is concluded.)
